items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: He’d bring in Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie and people like that, and Bud Powell.

ctx.x: Did your father— what made him convert and leave that faith?

I don’t know what it was. You know like Philadelphia, it’s a very kind of a religious kind of place. Everybody’s looking for something different to be. You know. I mean they don’t want to be the same as this guy. They want to be different from that guy. So maybe that’s how it all went down. But whatever it was, it could have been the music too because he was definitely a person who listened to a lot of music. He used to, I mean he used to buy all the records and stuff in the house, so he had that stuff. He wasn’t…
That’s just so interesting to me because Mom and Dad bringing home Charlie Parker.
